q: 26 नवंबर 2026 को सॉफ्टवेयर टेक्नोलॉजी पार्क्स ऑफ इंडिया (STPI) ने उत्तर प्रदेश के किस शहर में अपना 75वाँ केंद्र उद्घाटित किया?
e:
STPI opened its 75th centre in Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh on 26 November 2026 to boost Tier-2/3 IT exports and startup incubation (STPI का 75वाँ केंद्र 26 नवंबर 2026 को बरेली में खुला)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. STPI is an autonomous society under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), established in 1991.
2. Bareilly is also known for the Indian Veterinary Research Institute (IVRI, Izatnagar) and its bamboo/zari-zardozi craft.
3. On 18 November 2026, IIT Kanpur launched 'AI Kavach'.
qe: On 26 November 2026, Software Technology Parks of India (STPI) inaugurated its 75th centre in which city of Uttar Pradesh?

q: नवंबर 2026 में पंजाब में 'खेत बचाओ अभियान' मुख्य रूप से किस उद्देश्य से शुरू किया गया?
o: Protection of agricultural land and sustainable farming
e:
'Khet Bachao Abhiyan' was launched in Punjab in November 2026 to protect fertile farmland and encourage sustainable agricultural practices (नवंबर 2026 में पंजाब में कृषि भूमि संरक्षण हेतु 'खेत बचाओ अभियान' शुरू किया गया)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Punjab is known as the 'Granary of India' / 'Breadbasket of India' and was the epicentre of the Green Revolution.
2. Soil Health Card Scheme (launched 2015 from Suratgarh, Rajasthan) helps farmers optimize fertilizer usage.
3. Sustainable agriculture aligns with SDG-2 (Zero Hunger) and SDG-15 (Life on Land).
qe: In November 2026, 'Khet Bachao Abhiyan' was launched in Punjab primarily to address which concern?
oe: Protection of agricultural land and sustainable farming

q: 2026 में शिक्षा मंत्रालय द्वारा मराठी, पालि, प्राकृत, असमिया और बांग्ला के लिए 5 नए उत्कृष्टता केंद्र स्थापित किए जाने के बाद भारत में मान्यता प्राप्त शास्त्रीय भाषाओं की कुल संख्या कितनी है?
e:
Adding Marathi, Pali, Prakrit, Assamese, and Bengali to the existing 6 (Tamil, Sanskrit, Kannada, Telugu, Malayalam, Odia) brings India's total Classical Languages to 11 (भारत में कुल 11 शास्त्रीय भाषाएँ हैं)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Tamil was the very first Indian language accorded Classical Language status in 2004, followed by Sanskrit in 2005.
2. Pali is the language of Theravada Buddhist canon (Tripitaka), while Prakrit (Ardhamagadhi) is the language of early Jain Agamas.
3. Classical language criteria include high antiquity of early texts (1,500–2,000 years) and a distinct, original literary tradition.
qe: With the Ministry of Education (MoE) establishing 5 new Centres of Excellence (CoEs) in 2026 for Marathi, Pali, Prakrit, Assamese, and Bengali, what is the total number of recognized Classical Languages in India?

q: बड़े पैमाने पर समुद्री बचाव और आपदा समन्वय का परीक्षण करने के लिए किस भारतीय समुद्री बल ने 'SAREX-2026' का 12वाँ संस्करण आयोजित किया?
e:
The Indian Coast Guard (ICG) organized the 12th National Maritime Search and Rescue Exercise (SAREX-2026) (12वाँ SAREX-2026 भारतीय तटरक्षक बल द्वारा आयोजित किया गया)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. ICG's Maritime Rescue Coordination Centres (MRCCs) are located at Mumbai, Chennai, and Port Blair.
2. India's Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) extends up to 200 nautical miles from the coastal baseline under UNCLOS.
3. 'SAGAR' (Security and Growth for All in the Region) is India's Indian Ocean maritime vision.
qe: Which Indian maritime force organized the 12th edition of 'SAREX-2026' to test large-scale sea rescue and disaster coordination?

q: 2026 के अकादमी पुरस्कार (ऑस्कर) में सर्वश्रेष्ठ फिल्म (Best Picture) का पुरस्कार किस फिल्म ने जीता?
e:
'One Battle After Another' won Best Picture at the 2026 Oscars (ऑस्कर 2026 में 'वन बैटल आफ्टर अनदर' ने सर्वश्रेष्ठ फिल्म का पुरस्कार जीता)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. 'Oppenheimer' won Best Picture in 2024; 'Anora' in 2025; 'Parasite' (South Korea) was the first non-English language film to win Best Picture (2020).
2. At the 95th Oscars (2023), India won two Oscars: 'Naatu Naatu' (RRR, Best Original Song) and 'The Elephant Whisperers' (Best Documentary Short).
3. Dadasaheb Phalke Award (instituted 1969) is India's highest award in cinema.
qe: At the 2026 Academy Awards (Oscars), the Best Picture award was won by which film?

q:
2026 की सत्यापित विरासत एवं द्विपक्षीय घटनाओं पर आधारित निम्नलिखित दो कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: भारत और फ्रांस ने प्राचीन पांडुलिपियों के संरक्षण व डिजिटलीकरण के लिए एक समझौता ज्ञापन (MoU) पर हस्ताक्षर किए।
कथन II: 2026 के संरक्षण प्रयासों में चर्चित मुगलकालीन नूरजहाँ सराय आगरा में स्थित है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II
e:
Both statements are factually correct (दोनों कथन पूर्णतः सत्य हैं): India signed the manuscript conservation MoU with France, and Nur Jahan Sarai is located in Agra.
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Sarais (caravanserais) were fortified roadside inns along imperial highways providing lodging, water, and stables for travellers and merchants.
2. UNESCO's 'Memory of the World' Register preserves documentary heritage of global significance (including Rigveda manuscripts from India).
3. Agra was founded as a modern city by Sikandar Lodi in 1504 and served as the Mughal capital under Akbar, Jahangir, and early Shah Jahan.
qe:
Consider the following two statements based on verified 2026 heritage and bilateral developments:
Statement I: India and France signed an MoU for the conservation and digitization of ancient manuscripts.
Statement II: The Mughal-era Nur Jahan Sarai, highlighted in 2026 conservation efforts, is located in Agra.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
oe: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का कौन-सा नगर 'भारत की चर्म नगरी' (Leather City) के रूप में प्रसिद्ध है और गंगा नदी के तट पर स्थित है?
e:
Kanpur (on the right bank of the Ganga) is famous as India's Leather City and industrial hub (कानपुर को भारत की चर्म नगरी कहा जाता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Agra (on the Yamuna) is also a major footwear/leather cluster under ODOP.
2. Central Leather Research Institute (CLRI) is located in Chennai (CSIR lab).
3. Uttar Pradesh has the highest population of any Indian state (19.98 crore per Census 2011 — ~16.5% of India).
qe: Which city in Uttar Pradesh is known as the 'Leather City of the World' (or Leather Capital of India) and sits on the banks of the River Ganga?

q: भारत की आयतन के अनुसार सबसे बड़ी कृत्रिम झील 'गोविंद बल्लभ पंत सागर' (रिहंद बाँध) उत्तर प्रदेश के किस जिले में रिहंद नदी पर निर्मित है?
e:
Rihand Dam (Pipri, Sonbhadra district, UP) is constructed on the Rihand river (a tributary of the Son river) (रिहंद बाँध सोनभद्र जिले में स्थित है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Matatila Dam and Rajghat Dam are located on the Betwa river (Lalitpur/Jhansi region).
2. Narora Atomic Power Station (NAPS) is located in Bulandshahr district of Uttar Pradesh on the Ganga river.
3. Govind Ballabh Pant was the first Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh (awarded Bharat Ratna in 1957).
qe: The 'Rihand Dam' (Govind Ballabh Pant Sagar), India's largest artificial lake by volume, is built on the Rihand river in which district of Uttar Pradesh?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश की प्रथम महिला मुख्यमंत्री (और भारत के किसी भी राज्य की प्रथम महिला मुख्यमंत्री) कौन थीं?
e:
Sucheta Kripalani served as Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh from 1963 to 1967, becoming India's first woman CM (सुचेता कृपलानी उत्तर प्रदेश व भारत की प्रथम महिला मुख्यमंत्री थीं)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Sarojini Naidu ('Nightingale of India') was the first woman Governor of UP (and of any Indian state, 1947–49).
2. Vijayalakshmi Pandit was the first woman President of the United Nations General Assembly (1953).
3. UP has given India 9 Prime Ministers (including Nehru, Shastri, Indira Gandhi, Charan Singh, Rajiv Gandhi, V. P. Singh, Chandra Shekhar, Vajpayee, and Modi — representing UP constituencies).
qe: Who was the first woman Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh (and also the first woman Chief Minister of any Indian state)?

q: प्रयागराज के निकट कौशाम्बी जिले में स्थित कौन-सा प्रसिद्ध बौद्ध एवं जैन तीर्थ स्थल प्राचीन वत्स महाजनपद की राजधानी था?
e:
Kaushambi (on the Yamuna river) was the capital of Vatsa Mahajanapada (King Udayana) and is revered by both Buddhists (Ghoshitarama monastery) and Jains (birthplace of 6th Tirthankara Padmaprabha) (कौशाम्बी वत्स महाजनपद की राजधानी थी)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Of the 16 Mahajanapadas, 8 were located in present-day Uttar Pradesh: Kashi, Kosala, Malla, Vatsa, Kuru, Panchala, Shurasena, and Chedi.
2. Ahichchhatra (Bareilly) and Kampilya (Farrukhabad) were capitals of North and South Panchala respectively.
3. Shravasti was the capital of Kosala Mahajanapada.
qe: Which famous Buddhist and Jain pilgrimage site in Kaushambi district (near Prayagraj) was the capital of the ancient Vatsa Mahajanapada?

q:
सूची-I (उत्तर प्रदेश सांस्कृतिक/शैक्षणिक संस्थान) को सूची-II (स्थान) से सुमेलित कीजिए तथा सही कूट चुनिए:
सूची-I:
1. भातखंडे संस्कृति विश्वविद्यालय
2. उत्तर मध्य क्षेत्र सांस्कृतिक केंद्र (NCZCC)
3. भारतेन्दु नाट्य अकादमी
4. डॉ. भीमराव अम्बेडकर विश्वविद्यालय (स्था. 1927)
सूची-II:
(a) आगरा
(b) लखनऊ
(c) प्रयागराज
(d) लखनऊ
e:
Bhatkhande Sanskriti Vishwavidyalaya (est. 1926 as Marris College of Music) and Bharatendu Natya Akademi (est. 1975) are in Lucknow; NCZCC is in Prayagraj; Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar University (formerly Agra University, est. 1927) is in Agra (1-b, 2-c, 3-d, 4-a)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. University of Allahabad (est. 1887) is the oldest modern university in Uttar Pradesh (called the 'Oxford of the East').
2. UP Sangeet Natak Akademi (1963) and State Lalit Kala Akademi (1962) are also located in Lucknow.
3. National Kathak Institute is located in Lucknow.
qe:
Match List-I (UP Cultural Institution) with List-II (Location) and select the correct code:
List-I:
1. Bhatkhande Sanskriti Vishwavidyalaya
2. North Central Zone Cultural Centre (NCZCC)
3. Bharatendu Natya Akademi
4. Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar University (est. 1927)
List-II:
(a) Agra
(b) Lucknow
(c) Prayagraj
(d) Lucknow

q: 'फॉरवर्ड ब्लॉक' (मई 1939) के संस्थापक और आजाद हिंद फौज (INA) के सर्वोच्च सेनापति कौन थे?
e:
Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose founded the Forward Bloc in May 1939 after resigning from the INC presidency (Tripuri crisis) and reorganized the Azad Hind Fauj (INA) in Singapore in 1943 (सुभाष चन्द्र बोस ने फॉरवर्ड ब्लॉक की स्थापना की)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Netaji's birth anniversary (23 January) is celebrated nationwide as 'Parakram Diwas'.
2. He gave the iconic slogans 'Delhi Chalo', 'Jai Hind', and 'Give me blood, and I shall give you freedom'.
3. Captain Mohan Singh first conceived the INA in Malaya (1942), and Rash Behari Bose handed over its leadership to Subhas Chandra Bose in 1943.
qe: Who was the founder of the 'Forward Bloc' (May 1939) and Supreme Commander of the Azad Hind Fauj (INA)?

q: भारत में महात्मा गांधी का प्रथम सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन 'चम्पारण सत्याग्रह' (1917) किस शोषणकारी कृषि प्रणाली के विरोध में शुरू किया गया था?
e:
Under the Tinkathia system in Champaran (Bihar), European planters forced peasants to cultivate indigo on 3/20th (3 katthas per bigha) of their best land (तिनकठिया प्रणाली के विरुद्ध चम्पारण सत्याग्रह हुआ)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Local peasant leader Raj Kumar Shukla invited Mahatma Gandhi to Champaran during the 1916 Lucknow INC session.
2. Dr. Rajendra Prasad, Brajkishore Prasad, J. B. Kripalani, and Mahadev Desai assisted Gandhi in Champaran.
3. Gandhi's early Indian Satyagrahas in sequence: Champaran (1917) → Ahmedabad Mill Strike (Feb–Mar 1918, first hunger strike) → Kheda Satyagraha (Mar 1918, first non-cooperation).
qe: The famous 'Champaran Satyagraha' (1917), Mahatma Gandhi's first Civil Disobedience movement in India, was launched to protest against which exploitative agrarian system?

q: किस मुगल सम्राट ने 1564 में जजिया कर समाप्त किया और 'सुलह-ए-कुल' (सार्वभौमिक शांति) की नीति की घोषणा की?
e:
Emperor Akbar abolished slavery (1562), pilgrimage tax (1563), and Jizya (1564), anchoring his state ideology in 'Sulh-i-Kul' (अकबर ने 1564 में जजिया समाप्त किया और सुलह-ए-कुल नीति अपनाई)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Aurangzeb later re-imposed Jizya in 1679, and Jahandar Shah/Muhammad Shah finally abolished it permanently.
2. Akbar built Buland Darwaza at Fatehpur Sikri to commemorate his Gujarat victory (1572–73).
3. Ralph Fitch was the first English merchant to visit Akbar's court at Fatehpur Sikri (1585).
qe: Which Mughal emperor abolished the Jizya tax in 1564 and proclaimed the policy of 'Sulh-i-Kul' (Universal Peace)?

q: नील विद्रोह (1859–60) के दौरान नील किसानों की दुर्दशा का मार्मिक चित्रण करने वाले प्रसिद्ध बांग्ला नाटक 'नील दर्पण' (1860) के लेखक कौन थे?
e:
Dinabandhu Mitra wrote 'Nil Darpan' (published in Dhaka, 1860); Michael Madhusudan Dutt translated it into English (published by Rev. James Long) (नील दर्पण के लेखक दीनबन्धु मित्र थे)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Harish Chandra Mukherjee powerfully championed the indigo peasants in his newspaper 'The Hindu Patriot'.
2. Digambar Biswas and Bishnu Biswas led the Indigo Revolt in Nadia district, Bengal (1859).
3. The Indigo Commission (1860) confirmed coercive abuses by European planters.
qe: Who was the author of 'Nil Darpan' (1860), a powerful Bengali play depicting the plight of indigo cultivators during the Indigo Revolt (1859–60)?

q: 628 ई. में ब्रह्मगुप्त द्वारा रचित किस प्राचीन भारतीय खगोल एवं गणित ग्रन्थ में शून्य (0) और ऋणात्मक संख्याओं के साथ गणना के स्पष्ट अंकगणितीय नियम सर्वप्रथम प्रतिपादित किए गए?
e:
Brahmagupta (born in Bhinmal, Rajasthan) wrote 'Brahmasphutasiddhanta' (628 CE), giving explicit rules for zero and negative numbers as well as cyclic quadrilateral area (ब्रह्मगुप्त ने ब्राह्मस्फुटसिद्धान्त में शून्य के नियम दिए)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Bhaskaracharya II (12th century) wrote 'Siddhanta Shiromani' (comprising Lilavati, Bijaganita, Goladhyaya, and Grahaganita).
2. Aryabhata (499 CE) authored 'Aryabhatiya'; Varahamihira authored 'Brihat Samhita'.
3. Baudhayana's 'Sulbasutra' (~800 BCE) contains the earliest geometric statement of the Pythagoras theorem.
qe: Which ancient Indian treatise on astronomy and mathematics, authored by Brahmagupta in 628 CE, first formulated explicit arithmetic rules for computing with Zero (0) and negative numbers?

q: किस संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम ने भारत में पंचायती राज संस्थाओं (ग्रामीण स्थानीय स्वशासन) को संवैधानिक दर्जा प्रदान किया?
e:
The 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992 (effective 24 April 1993) added Part IX and the 11th Schedule, mandating a three-tier Panchayati Raj system and 1/3rd reservation for women (73वें संशोधन ने पंचायती राज को संवैधानिक दर्जा दिया)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. L. M. Singhvi Committee (1986) first strongly recommended constitutional recognition for Panchayati Raj.
2. Gram Sabha (Article 243A) consists of all registered voters in the village panchayat area.
3. PESA Act (1996) extends Part IX provisions to Fifth Schedule tribal areas.
qe: Which Constitutional Amendment Act granted constitutional status to Panchayati Raj Institutions (Rural Local Self-Government) in India?

q: भारत में शिक्षक शिक्षा कार्यक्रमों (जैसे B.Ed. और D.El.Ed.) के नियोजन, समन्वय और मानकों को बनाए रखने के लिए कौन-सा शीर्ष वैधानिक निकाय उत्तरदायी है?
e:
NCTE (National Council for Teacher Education), headquartered in New Delhi, became a statutory body in August 1995 under the NCTE Act, 1993 (NCTE शिक्षक शिक्षा के मानकों का नियमन करती है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Under NEP 2020, a 4-year Integrated Teacher Education Programme (ITEP) is envisaged as the minimum qualification for school teachers by 2030.
2. NAAC (National Assessment and Accreditation Council, HQ Bengaluru) accredits higher education institutions.
3. NEP 2020 proposes a single overarching Higher Education Commission of India (HECI) with four verticals (NHERC, NAC, HEGC, GEC).
qe: Which apex statutory body in India is responsible for planning, coordinating, and maintaining standards in Teacher Education programmes (such as B.Ed. and D.El.Ed.)?

q: भारतीय संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद के अंतर्गत सर्वोच्च न्यायालय मौलिक अधिकारों के प्रवर्तन के लिए रिट जारी कर सकता है, और उच्च न्यायालयों के लिए संगत अनुच्छेद कौन-सा है?
e:
Supreme Court issues writs under Article 32 (itself a Fundamental Right) and High Courts under Article 226 (सर्वोच्च न्यायालय अनुच्छेद 32 तथा उच्च न्यायालय अनुच्छेद 226 के अंतर्गत रिट जारी करते हैं)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Article 136 deals with Special Leave to Appeal (SLP) to the Supreme Court.
2. Article 227 confers the power of superintendence over all subordinate courts upon High Courts.
3. Article 214 states that there shall be a High Court for each State.
qe: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution can the Supreme Court of India issue a writ for the enforcement of Fundamental Rights, and what is the corresponding Article for High Courts?

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा संसदीय प्रस्ताव केवल लोकसभा में ही लाया जा सकता है, राज्यसभा में नहीं?
e:
Because the Council of Ministers is collectively responsible ONLY to the Lok Sabha (Article 75(3)), a No-Confidence Motion (requiring support of at least 50 members for admission) can be introduced ONLY in the Lok Sabha (अविश्वास प्रस्ताव केवल लोकसभा में लाया जा सकता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Similarly, Adjournment Motion and Censure Motion against the government are exclusive to the Lok Sabha.
2. Zero Hour (शून्य काल) is an Indian parliamentary innovation (since 1962) held immediately after Question Hour without prior notice.
3. Quorum to constitute a sitting of either House of Parliament is 1/10th of the total strength of the House (Article 100).
qe: Which of the following parliamentary motions can ONLY be moved in the Lok Sabha and NOT in the Rajya Sabha?

q: भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 315 के अंतर्गत राज्य लोक सेवा आयोग (SPSC) के अध्यक्ष व सदस्यों की नियुक्ति कौन करता है, और उन्हें पद से हटाने की शक्ति किसके पास है?
o: Appointed by Governor; Removed by Governor
Appointed by President; Removed by President
Appointed by Governor; Removed ONLY by the President
Appointed by Chief Minister; Removed by High Court
e:
Although the Governor appoints SPSC members, to safeguard independence they can be REMOVED ONLY by the President of India (after an inquiry by the Supreme Court for misbehaviour under Article 317) (नियुक्ति राज्यपाल करते हैं, किंतु पद से हटाने की शक्ति केवल राष्ट्रपति के पास है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Tenure of SPSC members: 6 years or up to 62 years of age (for UPSC members: 6 years or up to 65 years).
2. A Joint State Public Service Commission (JSPSC) can be created by an Act of Parliament on the request of concerned state legislatures (statutory, not directly constitutional).
3. Expenses of UPSC/SPSC are charged upon the Consolidated Fund of India/State respectively.
qe: Under Article 315 of the Constitution of India, who appoints the Chairman and members of a State Public Service Commission (SPSC), and who has the power to REMOVE them?
oe: Appointed by Governor; Removed by Governor
Appointed by President; Removed by President
Appointed by Governor; Removed ONLY by the President
Appointed by Chief Minister; Removed by High Court

q: बार-बार मार्ग बदलने और विनाशकारी बाढ़ लाने के कारण किस भारतीय नदी को 'बिहार का शोक' कहा जाता है?
e:
The Kosi river (originating in Tibet/Nepal as Saptakoshi) carries heavy Himalayan silt and frequently shifts its channel westward, earning the name 'Sorrow of Bihar' (कोसी को बिहार का शोक कहा जाता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Damodar river was historically known as the 'Sorrow of Bengal' (controlled via DVC dams).
2. Brahmaputra causes annual floods in Assam; Mahanadi was historically linked to floods in Odisha (controlled by Hirakud Dam).
3. Majuli (Assam, in the Brahmaputra) is the world's largest inhabited river island.
qe: Which Indian river is known as the 'Sorrow of Bihar' due to its frequent course-shifting and devastating floods?

q: कौन-सी रेखा भारत के लगभग मध्य से होकर गुजरती है और देश को उष्णकटिबंधीय दक्षिणी व उपोष्णकटिबंधीय उत्तरी जलवायु क्षेत्रों में विभाजित करती है?
e:
The Tropic of Cancer (23°30' N) passes through 8 Indian states: Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, and Mizoram (कर्क रेखा भारत के 8 राज्यों से गुजरती है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Mahi River (MP → Rajasthan → Gujarat) is the ONLY river in India that crosses the Tropic of Cancer TWICE.
2. Ranchi (capital of Jharkhand) lies almost directly on the Tropic of Cancer.
3. India's total geographical area is 32,87,263 sq. km (~2.4% of world land area, 7th largest country).
qe: Which Tropic passes almost centrally through India, dividing the country into tropical southern and subtropical northern climatic zones?

q: जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार, भारत के किस केंद्र शासित प्रदेश में लिंगानुपात (प्रति 1,000 पुरुषों पर महिलाएँ) सर्वाधिक दर्ज किया गया था?
e:
Among Union Territories in Census 2011, Puducherry recorded the highest sex ratio at 1,037 females per 1,000 males (पुडुचेरी का लिंगानुपात केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों में सर्वाधिक 1,037 था)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Among States, Kerala topped sex ratio (1,084), followed by Tamil Nadu (996) and Andhra Pradesh (993); Haryana had the lowest among states (879).
2. India's overall sex ratio in Census 2011 was 943; Uttar Pradesh's was 912 (highest in UP: Jaunpur at 1,024).
3. Daman & Diu had the lowest sex ratio among UTs (618).
qe: As per Census 2011, which Union Territory of India recorded the highest sex ratio (females per 1,000 males)?

q: 1955 में इंपीरियल बैंक ऑफ इंडिया के राष्ट्रीयकरण से किस बैंक की स्थापना हुई थी, जो आज भारत का सबसे बड़ा सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र का वाणिज्यिक बैंक है?
e:
The State Bank of India (SBI) was established on 1 July 1955 on the recommendation of the A. D. Gorwala Committee (All-India Rural Credit Survey) (1 जुलाई 1955 को SBI की स्थापना हुई)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Imperial Bank of India (1921) was created by merging three Presidency Banks: Bank of Bengal (1806), Bank of Bombay (1840), and Bank of Madras (1843).
2. 14 major private banks were nationalized on 19 July 1969, and 6 more on 15 April 1980.
3. Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) were first set up on 2 October 1975 (Prathama Bank, Moradabad, UP was India's first RRB).
qe: Which bank was formed in 1955 by nationalizing the Imperial Bank of India and is today India's largest public sector commercial bank?

q: लोक वित्त में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा भारत में केंद्र सरकार द्वारा लगाया जाने वाला एक 'प्रत्यक्ष कर' (Direct Tax) है?
e:
Direct taxes (Personal Income Tax, Corporate Tax, Securities Transaction Tax) are borne directly by the person/entity on whom they are levied and cannot be shifted (निगम कर प्रत्यक्ष कर है; GST व सीमा शुल्क अप्रत्यक्ष कर हैं)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Direct taxes are administered by CBDT (Central Board of Direct Taxes); Indirect taxes by CBIC (Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs).
2. Progressive taxation (higher rate for higher income) helps reduce income inequality, whereas indirect taxes are generally regressive.
3. Article 265 states: 'No tax shall be levied or collected except by authority of law.'
qe: In public finance, which of the following is a DIRECT tax levied by the Union Government in India?

q: 1990 से UNDP द्वारा प्रतिवर्ष प्रकाशित 'मानव विकास सूचकांक' (HDI — महबूब उल हक व अमर्त्य सेन द्वारा परिकल्पित) की गणना किन तीन आयामों के आधार पर की जाती है?
o: Health (Life Expectancy), Education (Mean & Expected Years of Schooling), and Standard of Living (GNI per capita PPP)
GDP Growth Rate, Inflation Rate, and Unemployment Rate
Industrial Output, Literacy Rate, and Export Volume
Infant Mortality, Agricultural Yield, and Per Capita Electricity
e:
HDI is the geometric mean of normalized indices across three dimensions: Long & Healthy Life (Life Expectancy at Birth), Knowledge (Expected & Mean Years of Schooling), and Decent Standard of Living (GNI per capita in PPP $) (स्वास्थ्य, शिक्षा और जीवन स्तर HDI के तीन आयाम हैं)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. HDI values range from 0 to 1.
2. Amartya Sen won the 1998 Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences for Welfare Economics ('Capability Approach').
3. Global Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) is published jointly by UNDP and Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative (OPHI).
qe: The 'Human Development Index' (HDI), published annually by UNDP since 1990 (conceptualized by Mahbub ul Haq and Amartya Sen), is computed using which three dimensions?
oe: Health (Life Expectancy), Education (Mean & Expected Years of Schooling), and Standard of Living (GNI per capita PPP)
GDP Growth Rate, Inflation Rate, and Unemployment Rate
Industrial Output, Literacy Rate, and Export Volume
Infant Mortality, Agricultural Yield, and Per Capita Electricity

q: किस विटामिन की कमी से स्कर्वी (मसूड़ों में सूजन, रक्तस्राव और घाव भरने में देरी) रोग होता है?
e:
Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid) deficiency causes Scurvy (विटामिन C की कमी से स्कर्वी रोग होता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Vitamin A deficiency → Night Blindness; Vitamin B1 → Beriberi; Vitamin D → Rickets/Osteomalacia.
2. Citrus fruits, Amla, and Guava are rich sources of Vitamin C.
3. Vitamin C is water-soluble and acts as an important antioxidant.
qe: Which vitamin deficiency causes Scurvy (swollen, bleeding gums and poor wound healing)?

q: प्रकाश की कौन-सी घटना यह स्पष्ट करती है कि दिन में स्वच्छ आकाश नीला और सूर्योदय/सूर्यास्त के समय सूर्य लाल दिखाई देता है?
e:
Rayleigh Scattering (intensity inversely proportional to λ⁴) scatters shorter-wavelength blue light strongly in all directions, making the sky look blue; at sunrise/sunset, longer atmospheric path leaves longer-wavelength red light (प्रकाश के प्रकीर्णन से आकाश नीला दिखाई देता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Rainbow formation involves Dispersion, Refraction, and Internal Reflection inside water droplets.
2. Mirage in deserts and sparkling of diamonds are due to Total Internal Reflection (TIR).
3. Sir C. V. Raman won the 1930 Nobel Prize in Physics for discovering inelastic scattering of light ('Raman Effect', 28 February — National Science Day).
qe: Which phenomenon of light explains why the clear daytime sky appears blue and the setting/rising sun appears reddish?

q: शैक्षिक प्रौद्योगिकी और साइबर सुरक्षा में 'फिशिंग' (Phishing) क्या है?
o: A technique for compressing large video lectures for low-bandwidth networks
A fraudulent attempt to steal sensitive credentials (passwords, OTPs, bank details) by masquerading as a trustworthy entity via email or links
A hardware cooling method used in high-speed supercomputers
A coding language used for building interactive school quizzes
e:
Phishing is a social-engineering cyberattack where attackers send deceptive emails, SMS (Smishing), or fake websites posing as legitimate institutions to steal user passwords and financial data (फिशिंग एक साइबर धोखाधड़ी है जिसमें विश्वसनीय संस्था बनकर पासवर्ड/संवेदनशील जानकारी चुराई जाती है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. CERT-In (Indian Computer Emergency Response Team) is India's national nodal agency for cybersecurity incidents.
2. National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal is cybercrime.gov.in (helpline 1930).
3. Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) and HTTPS verification help protect users against phishing attacks.
qe: In educational technology and cybersecurity, what is 'Phishing'?
oe: A technique for compressing large video lectures for low-bandwidth networks
A fraudulent attempt to steal sensitive credentials (passwords, OTPs, bank details) by masquerading as a trustworthy entity via email or links
A hardware cooling method used in high-speed supercomputers
A coding language used for building interactive school quizzes
